hardpoints_fleet.json.key: ship name as it appears in ship_specs.json

what_this_is: Derived hardpoint positions for every ship that has both mount data and a model in testing/_deploy/models. Positions come from the mount NAME plus the hull's own geometry.
what_this_is_NOT: Not CIG's coordinates. All 25,150 ports in ship_specs.json carry position: null — re-verified on this dataset. Nobody has the real numbers. These are close, not exact, and the viewer must say so.
units: pos_model is in the MODEL's own units, which are NOT the same across the library: 158 ships are in metres, 8 are normalised to roughly unit size, 1 is in centimetres. frame.model_units_per_metre records the measured scale per ship. `unit` is normalised to the hull's longest axis and is safe regardless.
